scenario.description: Patient wants to move an existing Tuesday appointment to Thursday afternoon.
scenario.goal: Appointment is confirmed moved to a Thursday afternoon slot.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Hi, I need to reschedule my appointment on Tuesday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure, I can help with that. Can I get your name and date of birth to pull up your appointment?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks Jane. I see your Tuesday 10am appointment with Dr. Lee. What day would you like to move it to?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I have a 2pm and a 3:30pm open on Thursday. Which works better?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great, you're all set for Thursday at 2pm with Dr. Lee. You'll get a confirmation text shortly. Anything else?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're welcome, have a great day.
